# Auth — Evidence

## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.303282e0"></a>**1. GoogleLoginButton is a client-side React component ('use client') that renders a Google OAuth sign-in button and delegates the login action and loading state to the useAuth hook.**
  [`GoogleLoginButton.tsx:1-37`](../GoogleLoginButton.tsx#L1-L37)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.bb264047"></a>**2. UserAvatar is a client-side React component ('use client') that renders a user avatar with a dropdown menu built on the HTML <details> element.**
  [`UserAvatar.tsx:1-83`](../UserAvatar.tsx#L1-L83)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.3458c6e3"></a>**3. index.ts is a barrel module that re-exports GoogleLoginButton and its GoogleLoginButtonProps type, and UserAvatar and its UserAvatarProps type.**
  [`index.ts:1-7`](../index.ts#L1-L7)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.b59e649e"></a>**4. UserAvatarProps is an exported interface requiring a user of type AuthUser and an onLogout callback that takes no arguments and returns void.**
  [`UserAvatar.tsx:6-9`](../UserAvatar.tsx#L6-L9)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.458794a1"></a>**5. GoogleLoginButton renders a button with the CSS class 'google-signin-btn' plus any caller-supplied className, is disabled while the login is loading, and carries the aria-label 'Sign in with Google'.**
  [`GoogleLoginButton.tsx:17-35`](../GoogleLoginButton.tsx#L17-L35)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.0d0488ed"></a>**6. While loading, GoogleLoginButton shows a LoadingSpinner and the text 'Signing in...'; otherwise it shows a GoogleIcon and the text 'Continue with Google'.**
  [`GoogleLoginButton.tsx:24-34`](../GoogleLoginButton.tsx#L24-L34)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.17a055dc"></a>**7. GoogleIcon is a module-private SVG component that renders the official Google 'G' logo in the four brand colors.**
  [`GoogleLoginButton.tsx:42-68`](../GoogleLoginButton.tsx#L42-L68)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.bf0ad798"></a>**8. LoadingSpinner is a module-private SVG component that renders an animated (animate-spin) loading spinner.**
  [`GoogleLoginButton.tsx:73-97`](../GoogleLoginButton.tsx#L73-L97)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.84bd8abf"></a>**9. UserAvatar closes its dropdown when a click occurs outside the details element, via a document-level click listener registered in a useEffect.**
  [`UserAvatar.tsx:18-28`](../UserAvatar.tsx#L18-L28)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.141f699a"></a>**10. UserAvatar's handleLogout closes the dropdown and then invokes the onLogout prop.**
  [`UserAvatar.tsx:30-35`](../UserAvatar.tsx#L30-L35)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.182bea78"></a>**11. The UserAvatar dropdown displays the user's picture, first and last name, and email, and includes a 'Sign out' button styled with the text-error class.**
  [`UserAvatar.tsx:37-81`](../UserAvatar.tsx#L37-L81)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.fd99686a"></a>**12. LogoutIcon is a module-private SVG component that renders a logout arrow icon.**
  [`UserAvatar.tsx:85-102`](../UserAvatar.tsx#L85-L102)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.4e3c25c4"></a>**13. GoogleLoginButtonProps is an exported interface with a single optional className string prop.**
  [`GoogleLoginButton.tsx:5-7`](../GoogleLoginButton.tsx#L5-L7)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.9d828014"></a>**14. The GoogleLoginButton component is documented as following Google's branding guidelines and as satisfying requirements 3.1 and 7.1.**
  [`GoogleLoginButton.tsx:9-13`](../GoogleLoginButton.tsx#L9-L13)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.5364eb81"></a>**15. The UserAvatar component is documented as satisfying requirements 3.3 and 3.4.**
  [`UserAvatar.tsx:11-14`](../UserAvatar.tsx#L11-L14)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-auth.553a2e3c"></a>**16. The auth components barrel is documented as satisfying requirements 3.1 and 3.3.**
  [`index.ts:1-4`](../index.ts#L1-L4)
